decision_basis: User requires autonomous decisions from public sources; STTAD paper Table II and audited public examples
baseline: B0 image accident-region YOLO; objective unchanged
region_semantics: Per-frame region covering parties involved in the same accident; not a physical contact point or a vehicle class
source_geometry: Public selected TXT inspected as class + pixel xyxy; preserve raw and convert only validated boxes
missing_label: unknown; exclude from supervised labels, never generate negative TXT
decode_error_or_invalid_box: exclude with explicit reason; retain source bytes
occlusion_without_visibility_flags: not_provided; do not infer visibility, hidden extent or missing labels
cadp_derived_occlusion: exclude proposal if any participant occluded, outside, missing, or overlapping source ignore region
cadp_001407: retain reviewed frame interval and original vehicle labels; derived envelope auxiliary only, not author region GT
negative_source: Reviewed DETRAC full sequences, TAD author-normal clips, plus exact ACCIDENT preimpact frames with author first-contact evidence and assistant whole-frame review
public_split_lists: retain as provenance, do not adopt missing entries or reuse as project split
timing: Do not infer capture FPS or seconds from file numbering/display render
near_duplicate_policy: Perceptual hash suggests checks only; DETRAC 20011/20012/20032 conservative scene group; never auto-claim independent cameras
additional_region_source: ACCIDENT version 9 author impact-region boxes; accepted samples only
accident_scope: Author bbox at verified impact only. Other frames unknown except exact preimpact frames in fingerprint-bound review; never propagate boxes or infer whole negative intervals.
accident_geometry: Retain author corners; exclude partial/uncertain party coverage rather than editing GT
accident_timing: Released-file PTS verified separately from original capture FPS; CADP timing unchanged
preimpact_rule: First half before impact, >=1 second released-file PTS margin, independently pixel/PTS verified; assistant whole-frame visual review; sparse exact-frame negatives only, no author-negative/user-review claim
pilot_scope: Basic accident-region image detector; reviewed public impact boxes + exact scoped preimpact negatives; hard negatives/long videos deferred by user
pilot_exclusions: No deployment, temporal event, false alerts/hour, independent-camera or full-benchmark claim from small pilot
